application: production React build served by actual Express API
checks: Production owner profile reports 50 loaded of 132 active matches rather than treating the first page as the collection
Keyboard and pointer pagination reach all 132 active records across three pages without duplicates
An older-page record exposes provenance, keyboard focus returns on Escape, correction preserves history, and deletion removes current/history/source/export content
Project, subject, source and text filters reset pages and return correct global counts, including an empty intersection
Changed filters clear obsolete records immediately during a held request and distinguish loading from an empty result
Initial search failure shows a retry action without stale records or a misleading empty state; retry recovers
Later-page failure keeps the 50 prior records, labels the prior successful request and retries the same page without duplicates
Concurrent canonical capture rejects continuation with a recoverable refresh action, preventing skipped or mixed pages
Candidates beyond the first 100 records can be confirmed with separate user evidence or explicitly dismissed, with corrected queue counts
Older export import reports existing records and exact source/evidence/tombstone exclusions without resurrecting forgotten content
A conflicting import rolls back newly inserted earlier rows and explains that no import records were committed
Invalid JSON and oversize file selection fail clearly; a subsequent valid file imports one new source/memory and restores no credentials
Identical reimport reports already-present records separately from newly imported records
Desktop and 390 px mobile pagination, imports and older-record provenance have no horizontal overflow and remain keyboard usable
Final-page keyboard load moves focus to the first appended record; held page completion preserves later filter focus and never steals focus out of an open provenance dialog
limitations: Synthetic records and PGlite validate application lifecycle and transport; no real provider, native PostgreSQL, installed MCP host or sustained archive load was exercised.
Request failures and held filter responses use deliberate Chromium interception.
Deletion uses the pre-priority4 baseline API; preview guard integration is verified separately by the parent session.
